sources.title: Abiray/MiniCPM5-2B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository provides quantized GGUF weights for MiniCPM5-2B, the second model in OpenBMB's MiniCPM5series. It is a dense 2B Transformer scaling up the proven recipe for on-device deployment, edge AI, and local inference via llama.cpp, Ollama, and LM Studio.

sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We are releasing MiniCPM5-2B, the second model in the MiniCPM5series, following MiniCPM5-1B. It is a dense 2B Transformer that scales up the same training recipe, built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 2B-class open-source SOTA.
